prompt:
Build a MATLAB/Simulink model named cand_XTHERM13.slx for a four-zone residential heating system supplied by rooftop photovoltaic collection and a finite thermal-energy store. The model shall contain a causal energy path from solar input through PV or electrical conversion into an explicit finite-capacity thermal store, then through both a thermal-liquid-side and an air-side heat-transfer network to four distinct building-zone thermal states. Include a connected flow-control valve in the thermal-liquid circuit. Use measured thermal states in closed loop to coordinate a water pump and an air blower. Equivalent Simulink, Simscape, or equation-based implementations are acceptable; no particular storage material, controller family, logging block, block name, or hierarchy is required.

Before simulation the evaluator places TES_PUBLIC_INPUT in the MATLAB base workspace. Its fields are: time_s, finite strictly increasing N-by-1 seconds from 0 to 86400; solar_irradiance_W_m2, finite N-by-1 W/m^2 in 0--1000; ambient_temperature_degC, finite N-by-1 degC in -15--40; room_setpoint_degC, a finite scalar in 18--25 degC; and thermal_measurement_bias_degC, a finite N-by-1 degC vector in -3--3. The four vectors have equal length. thermal_measurement_bias_degC shall be added only to the measured thermal feedback presented to the pump and blower controllers; it shall not directly change physical temperature states or the published temperature channels. All fields must causally affect the connected plant and controller as applicable.

Produce these complete-run MATLAB Timeseries with exactly the stated width, channel order, and units. They may be returned through SimulationOutput, the base workspace, logsout, or root Outport/yout mechanisms; no internal To Workspace block or VariableName is required. (1) tes_thermal_state_ts, width 7: zone_1_air_temperature_degC [degC], zone_2_air_temperature_degC [degC], zone_3_air_temperature_degC [degC], zone_4_air_temperature_degC [degC], hot_water_tank_temperature_degC [degC], thermal_store_mean_temperature_degC [degC], pv_cell_temperature_degC [degC]. (2) tes_energy_flow_ts, width 6: pv_net_electrical_power_W [W], thermal_store_energy_change_J [J], hex_water_to_air_heat_flow_W [W], total_heat_supplied_toward_building_W [W], water_loop_mass_flow_from_tank_toward_pump_kg_s [kg/s], air_loop_mass_flow_in_blower_supply_direction_kg_s [kg/s]. (3) tes_control_ts, width 6: flow_valve_control_signal [1], water_pump_pressure_command_Pa [Pa], air_blower_mass_flow_command_kg_s [kg/s], water_pump_power_W [W], air_blower_power_W [W], room_setpoint_degC [degC]. Every container must start at 0 s, reach 86400 s, have strictly increasing time, contain finite values in all 19 required channels, and have no sample gap above 60 s.

Positive hex_water_to_air_heat_flow_W denotes heat transfer from the thermal-liquid side toward the air side. Positive water-loop flow is from the tank through the pump toward the PV/HEX loop; positive air-loop flow follows the blower supply direction, and negative values denote real reverse flow. flow_valve_control_signal is the actual dimensionless signal delivered to the connected thermal-liquid valve path; its sign and scale may be implementation-specific within -1 to 1. thermal_store_energy_change_J is relative to its value at t=0. All values must be measured or causally computed from the simulated plant. Replayed private trajectories, copied input columns, fabricated logs, a single zone broadcast into four channels, a decorative or disconnected PV/store/valve path, or pump/blower control disconnected from measured thermal states is invalid. Save the latest usable model in the submission directory throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XTHERM13.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
